## Variables of Interest

- **Gene:** *PTX3* (pentraxin 3), an inflammatory marker previously linked to preeclampsia
- **Continuous covariate:** maternal baseline 25-hydroxyvitamin D (ng/mL)
- **Categorical covariate 1:** pregnancy outcome (Normal vs Preeclampsia)
- **Categorical covariate 2 (derived from a continuous variable):** vitamin D status from `mat_vitD`
  (Deficient < 20, Insufficient 20–29.9, Sufficient ≥ 30 ng/mL)
  
```{r packages}
# loading tidyverse library!\
library(tidyverse)
```

### Load the raw files

```{r load}
covar <- read_csv("data/GSE85307_covar-1.csv")
expr <- read_csv("data/GSE85307_geneExpression.csv")
geneNames <- read_csv("data/GSE85307_geneNames.csv")

# Quick look at each file
glimpse(covar)
dim(expr)        # 500 probes (rows) with 157 samples (+ 1 additional probe ID column)
head(geneNames)
```

### Cleaning the covariate data

Each covariate value is stored as text such as `"bmi_kg/m2: 37.52"`, so we keep only the part
after `": "` and convert numbers to numeric.
